signature.name: VTask.MonovaryOn
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {α : Type u_3} -> {β : Type u_4} -> [Preorder α] -> [Preorder β] -> (f : ι → α) -> (g : ι → β) -> (s : Set ι) -> Prop

conventions.statement: VTask.MonovaryOn f g ∅ holds for all f and g because the universal quantifier over an empty set is vacuously true.
conventions.note: Standard vacuous truth for universal quantification.
